sentences.text: THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED29.7.2011 PASSED IN MVC NO.1358/2008 ON THE FILE OF THE ADDL.
SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE & MACT, UDUPI, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

This is an appeal filed by the claimant aggrieved by the award passed in M.V.C.No.1358/2008, dated 29.07.2011 on the file of the Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, at Udupi, whereby the Tribunal granted a meager global compensation of an amount of Rs.28,000/-.
2.

entities.text: Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, at Udupi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is the case of the claimant that on 27.08.2005 when the claimant along with others was traveling as passengers in a bus from Belvai towards Hukratte side, at about 3.30 p.m., when the bus reached near Sanoor High School the driver of the bus drove the vehicle in a sharp curve rash and negligently lost control NC: 2023:KHC:37823 over the vehicle.
As a result, the bus fell on the right side of the road.
Many of the passengers sustained injuries.
3. It is the case of the present claimant that he was treated as inpatient from 27.08.2005 to 30.08.2005.

Thereafter the claimant was treated as inpatient in Father Muller's Hospital,
Mangalore from 14.09.2005 to 24.09.2005.
Exhibit-P13 is the wound certificate.

As per the wound certificate the claimant sustained the following three simple injuries viz., i. 2 x 1 cms. contusion over the right temporal region, ii. 3 x 2 cms. contusion over the upper part of left leg, iii. 3 x 3 cms.
contusion over the sternal region.
4. In Father Muller's Hospital it was diagnosed as Haemotoma of left leg.
The claimant produced medical bills amounting to Rs.9,469/-.
No Doctor was examined in this regard.

The Court below taking into consideration the nature of injuries, duration of hospitalization, medical NC:
2023:KHC:37823 expenses, and other expenses
granted a global compensation of Rs.28,000/-.
5. A common order was passed by the court below in twelve claim petitions and three appeals were listed today before this Court.

As it is submitted that one more case is pending, this Court had directed the Registry to place the same before this Court in the afternoon session and that is how the present matter is listed before this Court.

6. Learned counsel for the respondent - insurance company submits that the court below considering the evidence on record since no Doctors were examined except filing a bill amounting to Rs.9,469/- and producing Exhibit-13 wound certificate, the court below had rightly granted global compensation of Rs.28,000/-.
7. This Court having heard the learned counsel for either side perused the material on record, in this case the claimant had sustained three injuries and no Doctor was NC: 2023:KHC:37823 examined.

sentences.text: With regard to the haemotoma to the leg as per the Father Mullers Hospital a bill of Rs.9,469/- has been filed.
Under these circumstances the court below had rightly granted a global compensation of an amount of Rs.28,000/- and this court finds no reasons to interfere.
Accordingly, the appeal is Dismissed.
i) Registry is directed to return the Trial Court Records to the Tribunal, along with certified copy of the order passed by this Court forthwith without any delay.
ii) No costs.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
